The main takeaway from our work is that

the use of the CDC light trap in the field is not a reliable tool to assess the relative abundance of the different species of mosquitoes that can transmit malaria, JE and filariasis, in the study area.
the monitoring of malaria vectors should not be limited only to the presence of malaria vectors.

the use of a combination of molecular and entomological techniques can provide a more comprehensive assessment of mosquito species composition and vector abundance than the use of entomological techniques alone.
